KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_PROBE_HEIST_DESC: ARC seem to have entered a period of extended probing, sending guarded probes down en masse.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_PEPPERMINT_DESC: A mysterious harvesting machine has appeared, heavily guarded by the feared Queen. What kind of riches are to be found within?
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_CACHE_THEM_ALL_DESC: Storms have unearthed a number of old Raider Caches, but they are rigged to explode should they be exposed for too long. Hurry up and find them all.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOWER_DEFENCE_DESC: Someone has locked off the Launch Tower, hiding all their hard-earned loot at the top. ARC seems to have ramped up their defenses in response to the heightened activity.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_HUSKUS_POCUS_DESC: Something has caused ARC machines to go down on their own in great amounts, leaving husks scattered around Topside. A better opportunity to gather information and parts has rarely presented itself.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_HARVEST_SEASON_DESC: The weather has been unusually agreeable lately, and vital plants and fruits have been thriving. Get out there and gather your food before it is all gone.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_NIGHTRAID_DESC: Raiders have been finding especially good loot behind locked doors, and keys have been more plentiful. The heightened Raider activity has attracted more ARC than usual.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_HIDDENBUNKER_DESC: Someone has hacked the Outskirts Bunker's security system. Find the 4 buttons to unlock the doors, and be the first to plunder the treasure within.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_LOCKED_GATE_DESC: A clandestine group has activated the Gate's emergency shutdown protocol. 4 key cards need to be obtained to override it, and uncover whatever they're hiding.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_DESC: Geothermal fissures have erupted beneath the swamp, releasing both toxic gases and rare natural resources.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_ACID_RAIN_DESC: An especially sour rain corrodes everything on the surface, harming any Raider caught outdoors.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_ELECTROMAGNETIC_STORM_DE: Lightning strikes batter the surface; frying electronics, disrupting ARC machines, and electrocuting unsuspecting Raiders.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_SPEARMINT_DESC: A Matriarch has been sighted nearby. Her children seem hell-bent on keeping her from harm.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_THE_QUEENS_DESC: Multiple Queens have been spotted in the area, though no Harvester seems to be anywhere nearby.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_HEAT_WAVE_DESC: A scorching sun has been beating down on everything and everyone, making it exhausting just to get around. Stay in the shadows if you can.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE: The selected destination is no longer available.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TIMEOUT_MESSAGE_ALT: The selected destination is no longer available. Would you like to change your destination?
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_THERMALROCKS: Geothermal fissures have erupted beneath the swamp, allowing Raiders to collect rare Thermal Rocks amidst the toxic gases.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_TOXIC_SWAMP_CLEANAIR_DES: Geothermal fissures beneath the swamp are releasing toxic gases, requiring Raiders to activate Air Purifier antennas around the Hydroponic Domes.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_FROSTBITE_DESC: A cold front has swept in with snowfall, and a considerable drop in temperature. The air might feel crisp and brisk at first, but beware of frostbite. Candleberry bushes are bearing valuable fruit - they are now ripe for the picking.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_INCREASEDCRA: Increased amount of crashed ARC Couriers
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESC: Flocks of birds have been spotted around Buried City, gathering around chimneys for what many assume to be nefarious reasons.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_ONERETURNPOI: One Return Point unlocks after some time
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_ALLRETURNPOI: Return Points unlock after some time
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_REPAIREXTRACTIONS_DESC: Most Return Points have broken down, and will need to be repaired before they can be used.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_REPAIREXTRACTIONS_DESCAL: A widespread mechanical failure has shut down every return point to Speranza. Raiders must repair them to secure a way home, or hold out long enough for a fallback system to engage.
A widespread mechanical failure has shut down every return point to Speranza. Raiders must repair them to find their way back home.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESCALT1: Unusual bird activity has been reported around the chimneys on Buried City’s rooftops. Raiders who investigate may find valuable materials in their nests.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BIRD_CITY_DESCALT2: Unusual bird activity has been reported around Buried City. Raiders are encouraged to investigate.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_WINDSTORM_DESC: Strong winds are sweeping across the surface, affecting large parts of the area. Visibility and hearing may be reduced, so stay alert.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_WINDSTORM_DESCALT1: Strong winds are sweeping across the surface, affecting large parts of the area. The situation is less predictable than usual, so stay alert.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_EXTRACTOR_DESC: Groups of surveyors and vaporizers are scanning for valuable materials. Their discoveries could prove worthwhile, if you’re prepared for resistance.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BULLETPOINT_DECREASEDOVE: Decreased amount of overall loot value
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_EXTRACTOR_DESC_ALT: Surveyors and heavy backup are scanning for valuable materials. Their discoveries could prove worthwhile, if you’re prepared for resistance.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BURIED_TREASURE_DESC: Scouts have discovered a variety of trinkets and small finds buried in the sands around Riven Tides, along with a few less welcome things. Raiders are encouraged to use a Dockmaster’s Detector to uncover them.
KeysToEntries.ID_MAPCONDITION_BURIED_TREASURE_DESCALT1: The sands of Riven Tides conceal lost trinkets, forgotten valuables, and a few unpleasant surprises. Raiders looking for either will need a Dockmaster’s Detector.
